flags.why: The transitive construction “thẩm mĩ một bức tranh” is not natural Vietnamese.
flags.fix: Cô giáo giúp các em phát triển khả năng thẩm mĩ. = The teacher helps the children develop their ability to appreciate beauty.

flags.why: “Tương truyền” belongs to literary storytelling and needs a warning against treating it as ordinary conversational “it is said that”.
This use is mainly Southern, as documented in the [dictionary of Southern Vietnamese](https://dokumen.pub/tu-dien-tu-ngu-nam-bo.html).
The Vietnamese says he agreed to serve the sentence, not that he actually served it.
flags.fix: He agreed to serve his sentence without appealing.

flags.why: The example defines concentric circles instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Cô ấy vẽ ba đường tròn đồng tâm trên giấy. = She drew three concentric circles on the paper.
